ChurchStream is free software for **Seventh-day Adventist churches**: live streaming to YouTube and Facebook plus projection of hymns, Bible readings and announcements, from one simple control panel. It runs on Windows and Mac.

## Download

| Computer | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows** laptop or PC | **[ChurchStream-win-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.5/ChurchStream-win-x64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Apple chip** (M1–M4) | **[ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.5/ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Intel processor** | **[ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.5/ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip)** |

**Updating?** Copy the new files over your old ChurchStream folder; your **ChurchStream-data** folder (settings, songs, services) is kept. First time? See the install steps in the [README](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream#install-windows).

## New in 0.3.5: two cameras, better recordings and easier-to-read screens

**Two cameras**
- Add a **second camera** (USB camera, capture card or network camera) in Settings → Camera & sound, and switch with **Camera 1 / Camera 2** on the Live stream card or the **1** and **2** keys. The switch is instant and doesn't interrupt the stream.
- If camera 2 drops out (unplugged, loose cable), the stream carries on with camera 1 within a few seconds, and camera 2 comes back by itself when it works again. If the picture ever freezes, ChurchStream restarts the stream on its own.

**Recording**
- **Record this service** is now on the Live stream card, next to Go live.
- Choose the **recording quality**: the same as the stream (no extra work for the computer), or a better 720p or 1080p copy for editing and uploading later. A 1080p recording works even when the stream is 720p.
- **Record each camera on its own**, without slides or names, for editing a sermon video afterwards.

**Starting soon and thank-you screens**
- Go live with a **countdown** on the stream ("Our service begins in 4:59") that switches to the service by itself; **Start service now** starts sooner.
- End with **"Thank you for worshipping with us"** for a few seconds before the stream stops by itself.

**Easier-to-read screens** (Settings → Appearance)
- **Largest text size** and **Smallest text size**: slides use the largest size whenever the words fit and shrink only as needed.
- Words that don't fit at the smallest size **continue on the next slide** automatically ("Verse 1 (1/2)", "(2/2)"), keeping whole lines and Bible verses together.
- **Long lines wrap** onto the next line instead of making the whole slide small.

*Extra recordings (higher quality, or each camera) are encoded separately. With a graphics encoder that's light; on a laptop without one (Settings → Advanced shows "libx264"), try a short test first.*

## Good to know
- Projecting or streaming hymns still under copyright needs your church's **CCLI** licence (and the Streaming Licence for online use).
- ChurchStream is an independent project, not an official product of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.
